summary: This 8-K reports the completion of a $810.0 million private offering of 6.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031 by Stingray Compute LLC, a wholly-owned indirect subsidiary of Cipher Digital Inc. The notes were issued at 99.750% of par to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and Regulation S. Proceeds will finance the Stingray Facility data center, reimburse prior equity contributions, and fund debt service reserves. The notes amortize semi-annually after the Final Commencement Date to achieve a target debt service coverage ratio and are redeemable at the issuer's option from June 2028. This debt financing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
